conventions: עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה → 'workmen' is one rule 30 unit on the construct participle and its rectum, headed on the construct (rule 23, both lexemes inside the one word); the rectum's article stands outside the fusion and takes the single written 'the' as the fronted article of the chain (rule 29), and the 'of' before 'workmen' after יַד is that outer chain's relation (rule 19). Applied identically at 22.5 (twice) and 22.9.

הַמֻּפְקָדִים בֵּית יְהוָה → 'that have the oversight of the house of Jehovah': the article takes 'that' (rule 41), the hophal participle takes 'have the oversight' headed on 'oversight' (rule 44), and the supplied 'of the' goes to בֵּית as a bare locative accusative under rule 33, not to the participle under rule 44 — the noun is not the passive participle's direct object and another preposition ('in') would have served. Applied identically at 22.5 and 22.9.

וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר → 'brought the king word again': hiphil שׁוּב keeps 'again' in its own discontinuous unit under rule 44, since 'brought' alone does not write the returning; the marker is unrepresented and דָּבָר takes the bare 'word'. Applied identically at 22.9 and 22.20.
report: Read all 48 candidate lemma groups and both added units against the twenty verses. Every within-bucket difference is licensed by the source or the ASV: הַ is 'the' where written, a relative or 'that which' on a participle/adjective (rule 41), and unrepresented where a demonstrative or agreement article leaves it nothing (vv. 4, 8, 13, 16, 17, 19, 20) or where the ASV writes 'king Josiah' bare (v. 3); לְ is unrepresented only for לֵאמֹר (rule 27), the bare datives of 'told the king' / 'Tell the man' / 'delivered me' (rule 40) and the two resultative לְ beside a written הָיָה (v. 19, rule 21); אֵת takes 'of' for 'inquire of' (vv. 13, 18) and 'even' for the appositive it stands on (v. 16), else unrepresented.

Constructions repeated across verses are analysed identically: עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה → 'workmen' fused with the rectum's article taking the written 'the' (vv. 5 ×2, 9); הַמֻּפְקָדִים בֵּית יְהוָה → 'have the oversight' on the participle and 'of the house' on the bare locative noun under rule 33 (vv. 5, 9); הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל → single 'the' on the noun's article, agreement article unrepresented (vv. 4, 8); hiphil שׁוּב → 'brought ... again' with 'again' kept in the verb's unit (vv. 9, 20); the וַיְהִי frame gives 'that' to הָיָה where the apodosis has no waw (v. 3) and to the apodosis waw where it has one (v. 11), as rule 45 directs.

The two added units are correct: v. 18 'As touching' before a fronted nominal with no marker or preposition (rule 16), v. 19 'thee' supplied as object of שָׁמַעְתִּי with no object morpheme (rule 44). No supplied word is marked added in one verse and folded into a morpheme in another.

BSB disagreements are all convention differences: לֵאמֹר and bare-dative לְ, object markers, agreement/demonstrative articles, and the resumptive הִיא of v. 13 inside a relative whose finite verb already carries 'is kindled'. None is a genuine error.

Two textual units (v. 5) are underdetermined with the base reading retained and compatible with the ASV; rule 53 does not arise. Nothing here generalises beyond what the contract already states; no promotions or amendments.
